content: {"praised":["Production values top‑notch with good sets, costumes, props, SFX","Stories evolving, some with early 70s European Sci‑Fi quality","Serious tone and strong acting, especially Barry Morse","Good pacing and engaging themes in many episodes","Overall visual quality impressive for the era"],"criticized":["Writing not engaging, stories lack depth","Frustrating, cerebral attempts feel forced","Plot pacing sometimes uneven","Characters underdeveloped in some episodes","Humor sparse, tone too serious for some viewers"]}
